label: The hole, every year
sub: Average annual shortfall FY28–FY30, after each year’s cuts compound

label: What business growth would have to deliver
sub: of new commercial value every year — about 67 more average businesses a year, on top of the 234 the town has, or 15 typical developments

label: Cutting every sport, band and club
sub: All athletics, all arts and music, all clubs — eliminated entirely. Covers one year, once, and then the column is empty

label: Health insurance, shifted 75/25 → 70/30
sub: in year one after the 25% owed back to employees ($266,564 headline) — and it costs a family on the broadest plan $2,198 a year

label: Athletic fee that would make sports self-funding
sub: a season, against the $345,458 it costs to field the teams that survived AND get them to away games. Against the $217,908 the budget actually funds — which pays for no transportation at all — it is $440. Restoring the full $451,830 program is out of reach at any fee

label: Activity fee to make band, music and clubs self-funding
sub: per student per activity, covering the $106,244 those programs cost. Reachable — but a steep charge for a school club
